entries.category_description: Window cleaning and cleaning in private households
entries.comment: Tabel I prov. b.20: regular cleaning services regarding the interior of private households (including closed corridors) are included. Excluded: cleaning services regarding the exterior of private households, cleaning services regarding other buildings than private households and cleaning services that are not considered regular cleaning services regularly performed by a cleaner (such as special services performed with special equipment, e.g. cleaning of chimney, central heating).
